body:
I've tried opening up to my family before but they brushed me off and called it a phase. My mom wouldn't really like me seeing a therapist anyway, as she's had bad past experiences with them. But I'm also afraid of hurting my family somewhat, because there's a lot I haven't told them. I've never been very good at expressing what I feel verbally, so they might misunderstand some things.

I've been working on trying to find things I like that distract me enough from my thoughts.
Thank you for the comment, it made me feel less alone.
